misconceptions.description: Generating images that decorate the slide instead of explaining the idea
misconceptions.trigger: learner adds an AI image of a generic robot to a slide about data pipelines
misconceptions.feedback: Ask what the image must teach; if removing it loses no meaning, it is decoration, not explanation.

misconceptions.description: Using a vague image prompt and accepting whatever the model returns
misconceptions.trigger: learner prompts 'make a nice tech picture' and uses the first result unchanged
misconceptions.feedback: Write a prompt that names the concept, the parts to show, and the relationship; iterate until the image matches the idea.

misconceptions.description: Treating an AI-generated diagram as factually accurate without checking it
misconceptions.trigger: learner uses a generated flowchart whose arrows contradict the real process
misconceptions.feedback: Verify every label and arrow against the real artifact; a generated diagram is a draft, not a source of truth.
